final: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.country AS country, AVG(cs.wins) AS a FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId=cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId=r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM c), k AS (SELECT c.country, c.a FROM c, m1 WHERE c.a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.a FROM k, m2 WHERE k.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(f.a) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(f.a - (SELECT m FROM m1)) AS mean_excess_over_m1, AVG(f.a - (SELECT m FROM m2)) AS mean_excess_over_m2 FROM f
